source.title: How to Wear a Polo Shirt Without Looking Like a Middle Manager (Art of Manliness)

tips.text: A polo should be slim but not tight: sleeves mid-bicep, hem around mid-fly; avoid baggy polos with long sleeves.
tips.why: A shapeless polo looks like an afterthought.

tips.text: Wear pique or jersey cotton polos away from the golf course, not shiny synthetic ones.
Pair a polo with tailored chinos, trousers or well-fitting jeans, and loafers, chukkas or clean sneakers rather than boxy dress shoes.
tips.why: Refined but relaxed pieces keep a polo modern.

tips.text: Layer a light jacket, cardigan or sport coat over a polo when the weather allows.
tips.why: A layer adds interest beyond the polo alone.

tips.text: A polo tucked into pleated khakis with boxy dress shoes reads corporate; keep it relaxed.
tips.why: It looks like an office uniform.

outfits.outfit: polo navy slim preppy, trousers beige casual +chinos, dress-shoes brown formal +loafers
outfits.why: A navy polo with light trousers looks put-together.

outfits.outfit: polo white preppy, jeans denim casual, dress-shoes brown formal +loafers
outfits.why: A polo with good jeans and loafers is refined yet relaxed.

outfits.outfit: polo black smart casual, trousers grey smart casual, sneakers white minimal
outfits.why: Dress trousers with clean sneakers: relaxed and modern.

outfits.outfit: polo navy casual, trousers beige casual +chinos, sneakers red casual
outfits.why: Chinos with red sneakers add a pop of colour.

outfits.outfit: polo light blue smart casual, trousers beige smart casual +chinos +pleated, dress-shoes black smart
outfits.why: Tucked polo, pleated khakis and boxy shoes read corporate.
